topic.title: Molecular Geometry and Neural Quantum Models
topic.area: Molecular, Biological, and Quantum Machine Learning
topic.overview: Machine learning can approximate energies, forces, wavefunctions, and molecular structures that are expensive to obtain through physical calculations. This topic examines representations that respect or learn geometric transformations, as well as architectures and benchmarks for scaling atomistic prediction. It connects molecular generation with the more detailed electronic descriptions used to derive physical observables.
topic.whyItMatters: Fast surrogates can expand the range of systems and candidate molecules researchers explore. Their usefulness depends on physical accuracy, transfer across chemical domains, and computational cost, not only performance on familiar configurations.
topic.evolution: Early examples study constrained atomic representations and reaction prediction. Later work develops invariant molecular features, equivariant wavefunction prediction, and conformation generation. Recent representatives scrutinize scaling tradeoffs, align generators with learned force fields, and benchmark neural-wavefunction expressivity across different quantum regimes.
openQuestions: When should symmetry be imposed architecturally rather than learned from data?
How can benchmarks reveal failures outside the chemical or quantum regimes used for training?

papers.title: Reconstructing Heterogeneous Biomolecules via Hierarchical Gaussian Mixtures and Part Discovery

papers.title: Space Group Equivariant Crystal Diffusion

papers.title: Symmetry-Preserving Conformer Ensemble Networks for Molecular Representation Learning

papers.title: The Catechol Benchmark: Time-series Solvent Selection Data for Few-shot Machine Learning

papers.title: TITAN: A Trajectory-Informed Technique for Adaptive Parameter Freezing in Large-Scale VQE

papers.title: Towards Unified and Lossless Latent Space for 3D Molecular Latent Diffusion Modeling

papers.title: UMA: A Family of Universal Models for Atoms

papers.title: A Cartesian-3j Framework for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials

papers.title: AutoMat: Physics-Guided Agentic Reasoning for Solving Ill-Posed Inverse Microscopy Problems

papers.title: BLIPs: Bayesian Learned Interatomic Potentials

papers.title: CatFlow: Co-generation of Slab-Adsorbate Systems via Flow Matching

papers.title: Coarse-Grained Boltzmann Generators

papers.title: Coupled Cluster con MoLe: Molecular Orbital Learning for Neural Wavefunctions

papers.title: CryoACE: An Atom-centric Framework for Accurate and Automated Model Building in Cryo-EM
papers.tldr: CryoACE reconstructs atomic protein structures and dynamic conformations by refining density features directly at atomic coordinates.

papers.title: Deep Scientific Reasoning under Physical Constraints: Structure-Aware Spectrum Prediction

papers.title: E2Former-V2: On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention with Linear Activation Memory

papers.title: Efficient and Safe Molecular Assembly via Reinforcement Learning and Constraint Solving

papers.title: Efficient Equivariant High-Order Crystal Tensor Prediction via Cartesian Local-Environment Many-Body Coupling

papers.title: Efficient Prediction of SO(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Matrices via SO(2) Local Frames

papers.title: Excited Pfaffians: Generalized Neural Wave Functions Across Structure and State

papers.title: From Basis to Basis: Gaussian Particle Representation for Interpretable PDE Operators

papers.title: From Evaluation to Design: Using Potential Energy Surface Smoothness Metrics to Guide ML Interatomic Potential Architectures

papers.title: Large-Scale Molecular Dynamics Simulation: Direct Interatomic Modeling with Dilated Message Passing
